		custom_cost_text = zin_world_dragon_pact_cost_tt
		complete_effect = {
			if = {

			else = {
				add_political_power = -150
			}
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_to = ROOT }
			zin_world_give_dragon = yes
			add_to_variable = { zin_world_dragon_pacts = 1 }
			set_country_flag = zin_war_dragon_pact
		}
		ai_will_do = {
			# The Dragon Pact (spec, AI): an elven realm asks when a dark power holds one of its states, or when the Gathering Dark is at 75.
			# Under the historical path the Magical Forest's Pact of 4A 1755 is its focus Wings Over the Woods: it never takes the decision before that
			# focus, nor in the 365 days after the focus's Pact.
			base = 0
			modifier = {
				add = 100
				any_enemy_country = {
					zin_diplo_is_dark_power = yes
					any_controlled_state = { is_owned_by = ROOT }
				}
			}
			modifier = {
				add = 100
				check_variable = { var = global.zin_gathering_dark value = 75 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				zin_rules_is_historical = yes
				original_tag = MAG
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_completed_focus = zin_magical_forest_wings_over_woods }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = zin_war_dragon_pact days > 365 } }
				}
			}
		}
